PDF Enhanced Sphere Tracing
In this paper we present several performance and quality enhancements to classical sphere tracing: First, we propose a safe, over-relaxation-based method for accelerating sphere tracing. Second, a method for dynamically preventing self-intersections upon converting signed distance bounds enables controlling precision and rendering performance.
